message:
## Vulnerability Digest

**Scan window:** 2026-11-04 13:10 IST to 2026-11-05 13:10 IST

No newly reported or newly updated vulnerabilities in the last 24 hours could be credibly matched to the normalized components and versions in the DLL software inventory.

### Findings

No relevant new vulnerabilities found.

### MongoDB ecosystem sweep

The required dedicated sweep covered MongoDB Server (Community and Enterprise), mongod, mongos, Atlas and Atlas services, Ops Manager, Cloud Manager, Compass, mongosh, Database Tools, Kubernetes Operator, official drivers and libraries, connectors, BI Connector, Charts, Realm/App Services, and official integrations. No credible MongoDB-related advisory or CVE was newly reported or updated within the scan window. The most recent items visible on the [MongoDB security alerts page](https://www.mongodb.com/resources/products/alerts) predate this window and were excluded.

**Closing:** No immediate vulnerability review is indicated from this 24-hour scan. Continue routine monitoring; older advisories and search-index refreshes were not treated as new findings.
